description:
Early radio support from BBC 6Music, Bandcamp Selects, NTS and Rinse FM, as well as praise from garage luminary Todd Edwards: 'really hot...it reminds me of what inspired me from the 90s'.

Echo Juliet returns with the first in a series of EPs exploring nature and wellbeing, following her critically acclaimed debut EP Abandon Reality and remix from Gold Panda.

Lead track ‘Lift Your Face to the Sun’ unfurls from sparkling harp and broken beat into a pulsating house groove, inspired by a core memory from a festival. “I remember watching one of my favourite DJs play in the woods, with sunlight coming through the trees, surrounded by hundreds of people and great music. I wanted to capture that energy in this track” she says.

Completing the release, ’Halfway in Light’ provides a Chicago-inspired deep house groove exploring light and dark textures and the concept of yin and yang. 

“I wrote these tracks during some tough times” says Echo Juliet when asked about inspiration for the new release. “The writing process became the antidote to what my family and I were going through. I built a daily ritual of producing and then walking in green spaces while listening back to what I made.“ 

“The combination of music and nature was healing for me, and it brings me hope to have created something I love out of difficult experiences. I hope this music can bring joy and light for others too."

In memory of Mike (1999-2024)
